extra: Read CLAUDE.md and the CLAUDE.md of every folder you touch before editing. docs/dashboard-spec.md is the single source of truth; if the implementation must differ from it, stop and report instead of changing code.
Do not edit docs/. Put needed doc/decision changes in the PR body under '문서 수정 필요'.
Commit titles: <type>(<area>): <Korean summary>, e.g. fix(robot): 수동 투입을 배치 배합에 반영. Code identifiers in English, comments in Korean.

No GitHub Actions CI: run the local verify commands and paste totals in the PR body. Browser checks (test:integration, app/scripts/*.mjs) need local Chromium; run them alone, not in parallel. If Windows reserves port 4099 use INTEGRATION_PORT=4399.
Do not decide open questions (docs/questions.md); proceed with the prototype assumptions in docs/dashboard-spec.md.
